critical_code_review_comments: server.py:4580 _parse_az_date correctly handles 4 formats (ISO, DD/MM/YYYY, DD.MM.YYYY, DD-MM-YYYY) and Excel-serial datetime via openpyxl cellDates, returning '' on invalid input. No DoS / injection risk.

server.py:4607 import_obligations_excel guards with check_permission('obligations','write'); matches companies by brand_name; merges first+last via 'Ad Soyad' with .strip(); if both empty leaves owner_name untouched — exactly the required behaviour.
Obligations.jsx:123 splitOwnerName splits on /\s+/, taking first token as Ad and rest as Soyad — round-trips correctly with backend merge.

dateUtils.js formatDate slices the date portion before T/space and uses padStart — avoids common UTC-offset bug where 'YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00Z' would render as previous day in UTC+4 locales. Good defensive coding.
